candidates.violated_requirement: The state transition at sf6 should go to sf1 when data is 1 and s1 when data is 0, but the mutation swaps these targets. This causes incorrect state transitions when processing the sixth bit of a group, leading to wrong match/not_match outputs.
candidates.spec_basis: Module must detect sequence 011100 from input data in non-overlapping groups of six bits, with correct state transitions for both match and non-match cases.
